audit.whatIsWrong: early claimed 'Ziggs out-ranges your E with bouncing Q'. Bouncing Bomb is 850; Glacial Path is 1050. The ability he actually out-ranges is Ice Shard, 850 to 725. Nothing in the matchup mentioned Short Fuse or that Satchel Charge scales on health.
audit.why: The claw is the one tool that reaches further than his poke, so telling the player it is out-ranged removes their only plan. Short Fuse periodically arms an empowered auto and its cooldown drops every time he casts — the wind-up is the tell that he is about to be in range, which is the exact autoreset entry in the missing-interactions file. Satchel Charge is flagged percentHealth, so building raw health does not blunt it.
audit.corrected: Range claim fixed to Q-vs-Q; Short Fuse's wind-up stated as the step-back cue; the health-stacking point folded into whys[3].

audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer phases[N].side read Ziggs/Ziggs/Skill/Skill/Skill/Skill/Skill; content win[N] and the packet levelChart both read Skill/Skill/Skill/Skill/Lissandra/Lissandra/Lissandra. Five rows disagreed.
audit.why: Levels 1-2 are even — his Q is 850 to your 725 but costs 50-70 mana a throw and cannot kill, and Satchel Charge does not exist until 3. From 6 a 550-range point-and-click stun beats a champion whose only escape is a 20s knockback.
audit.corrected: Full chart moved to match content and packet, every side edit paired with its rewritten why.

notes: Range error fixed: the matchup said Bouncing Bomb out-ranges Glacial Path. It is 850 against 1050 — the claw is the longest reach in the lane apart from his ultimate; what he out-ranges is Ice Shard, 850 to 725. Chart: full layer disagreed with content on five of seven rows; content already matched the packet, so only the full layer moved, each side edit paired with its why. No win[N] edits were possible — content already holds the correct values. Both missingInteractions entries are now stated: Short Fuse's empowered-auto wind-up as the step-back cue, and Satchel Charge scaling on health so stacking HP is not the answer. Not asserted (kit silent): whether Satchel Charge's knockback can displace Lissandra out of Ring of Frost's cast or interrupt the claw recast, and whether the Satchel knock is reduced by tenacity. spikes[1], whys[5] and mid reference an 'E-Flash' gap-close; Flash-buffering is not in Riot's text and I did not verify it, so those strings were left as written.
